cohort: 174 pregnancies of women with type 1 diabetes
finding: While CSII use was initially associated with higher cesarean section rates and lower congenital malformations, these associations became insignificant after adjusting for HbA1c levels and other factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were initially higher in the CSII group, but this association lost significance after adjusting for confounders.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was similar between groups
